terminal.choose_conversation_mode: Choose conversational mode for this run: 'casual' prioritizes ordinary character conversation until three quarters of the earliest-expiring table timer has elapsed; 'ultra casual' keeps that casual posture and casual phase timing throughout the entire game; 'strategic' keeps conversation centered on the social-deduction game.
terminal.choose_manual_seating: Do you want to manually assign the starting seats? yes or no

terminal.choose_context_mode:
Choose context handling for this new game:
- 'keep': keep the saved ongoing scenario context, clothing, full relationship records, and game-only relationship additions as they currently are.
- 'fresh': start from permanent initial context and base relationships, then enter replacement game-only scenario context, choose clothing handling, and enter fresh shared, A-to-B, and B-to-A game-only relationship context.
- 'base': use only permanent initial context and base relationships, omit clothing, and use no temporary additions.
Previous-game summaries remain archived but are excluded from all three modes.

Existing session data found in {path} ({note}). Choose one:

- 'reroll roles' to reuse these characters and established relationships with reassigned roles, wiping game state/memory/logs
- 'exact setup' to reuse these characters, roles, established relationships, starting tables, and starting movement cooldowns while wiping game state/memory/logs

terminal.stop_after_llm: Stopping simulation immediately without saving a mid-timestep state.
event.bishop.attempt: {bishop} reveals their {role} card and attempts to use their {role} ability on {target} by guessing {family}.
event.bishop.correct_guess: The {glossary_role_Bishop} {bishop} correctly guesses {target}'s family as {family}, so {target} must leave for {destination}.
event.bishop.wrong_guess_hard_reveal: {target} reveals their {role} card to prove that the {glossary_role_Bishop} {bishop}'s guess of {family} was wrong.
event.lock.nullified_by_theft: {holder}'s {role} lockdown on {targets} is nullified because {baron} stole the {role} card.
event.movement.blocked_by_timer: {target} cannot leave or be forced out by {benefactor}'s {role} ability because the {table} timer lockdown is final.
event.timer.expired: The {table} timer expires; {table} is now under final timer lockdown. Nobody seated there can leave by normal movement or be moved out by any voluntary or forced role ability, though players may still enter.
event.table.no_action: The table falls quiet; no action bid is strong enough for anyone to act.
event.card.reveal_failed: {character} tries to reveal their {role} card, but cannot prove it because they do not have that role card.
event.card.reveal_global: {character} reveals their {role} card to all tables without using the ability.
event.card.reveal_without_ability: {character} reveals their {role} card without using the ability.
event.card.global_reveal_heard: From the {table}, {description}; the reveal was made loudly and visibly enough for every table to verify, but only {glossary_role_Baron}s physically at the origin table can react to it.
event.ability.attempt: {character} reveals their {role} card and attempts to use the {role} ability on {target}.
event.ability.missing_card: {character} reaches for their {role} card, but cannot use the ability because they do not have it.
event.queen.blocked_by_farmer: {target} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Farmer} and is immune to {queen}'s {glossary_role_Queen} drag; {target} remains at {table}.
event.queen.blocked_by_king: {queen}'s {glossary_role_Queen} drag attempt on {target} fails because {target}'s family, {family}, is held by a {glossary_role_King}'s lockdown at {table}.
event.queen.exile_attempt: {queen} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Queen} and attempts to use the {glossary_role_Queen} ability on {target} while being exiled by {glossary_role_Bishop} {bishop}.
event.queen.exile_drag: {queen} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Queen} while being exiled and drags {target} to {destination} using the {glossary_role_Queen} ability.
event.queen.drag_departure: {queen} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Queen} and leaves for {destination} while dragging {target} using the {glossary_role_Queen} ability.
event.queen.drag_failed_departure: {queen} leaves for {destination} after the {glossary_role_Queen} drag attempt on {target} fails against the {glossary_role_King}'s lockdown.
event.spinster.exile_attempt: {spinster} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Spinster} and attempts to mark {target} while being exiled by {glossary_role_Bishop} {bishop} to {destination}.
event.spinster.mark_departure: {spinster} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Spinster}, attempts to mark {target}, and leaves {origin} for {destination}.
event.spinster.mark_departure_resolved: {spinster} leaves for {destination} after marking {target} with the {glossary_role_Spinster} ability.
event.spinster.reveal_blocked_nun: {target} is forced by the departing {glossary_role_Spinster} {spinster} to reveal a role card, but shows the {glossary_role_Nun} protection card instead, so the forced reveal fails.
event.spinster.reveal_missing_card: {target} is forced by the departing {glossary_role_Spinster} {spinster} to reveal a role card, but cannot produce their own role card, so the forced reveal fails.
event.spinster.forced_reveal: {target} is forced by the departing {glossary_role_Spinster} {spinster} to reveal their {role} card.
event.innkeeper.attempt: {innkeeper} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Innkeeper} and attempts to declare as {glossary_role_Innkeeper} to lock down everyone at the {village}.
event.innkeeper.lock: {innkeeper} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Innkeeper}, declares as {glossary_role_Innkeeper}, and locks down everyone at the {village}.
event.king.lock: {king} reveals their {glossary_role_card_King} and locks down all currently present members of {family} at {table}.
event.nun.protection: {target} reveals the {glossary_role_card_Nun} protecting them and is protected from {source}'s {role} effect.
event.nun.give_protection: {nun} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Nun} and gives it to protect {target}.
event.nun.show_failed: {character} tries to show the {glossary_role_card_Nun} protecting them, but cannot produce it.
event.nun.show_protection: {character} reveals the {glossary_role_card_Nun} protecting them without revealing their actual role card.
event.priest.force_reveal: The {glossary_role_Priest} {priest} forces {target} to reveal their {role} card.
event.thief.blocked_by_thief: {thief}'s {glossary_role_Thief} swap attempt on {target} fails because {glossary_role_Thief}s are immune to {glossary_role_Thief} swaps.
event.thief.swap: {thief} reveals their {old_role} card and forcefully swaps roles and cards with {target}. {target} is now the {glossary_role_Thief}, while {thief} is now {thief_new_role}.
event.baron.attempt_trophies: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron} and attempts to steal {target}'s {glossary_role_Baron} trophies without taking the {glossary_role_Baron} role card.
event.baron.attempt_block_steal: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron} and attempts to block {target}'s {role} ability and steal the {role} card.
event.baron.attempt_steal: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron} and attempts to steal {target}'s {role} card after the reveal.
event.baron.countersteal_trophies: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron}, countersteals {target}'s {glossary_role_Baron} trophies (known visible trophies: {known}), and does not take the {glossary_role_Baron} role card.
event.baron.block_trophies: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron}, blocks {target}'s {glossary_role_Baron} ability, and steals {target}'s {glossary_role_Baron} trophies without taking the {glossary_role_Baron} role card.
event.baron.steal_trophies: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron} after {target}'s reveal and steals {target}'s {glossary_role_Baron} trophies without taking the {glossary_role_Baron} role card.
event.baron.block_steal: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron}, blocks {target}'s {role} ability, and steals the {role} card.
event.baron.steal_after_reveal: {baron} reveals their {glossary_role_card_Baron} after {target}'s reveal and steals the {role} card.
event.card.retrieval_unavailable: {character} considers retrieving a card, but no valid retrieval condition is currently met.
event.card.request_nun_return: The {glossary_role_Nun} {nun} asks {holder} to return the {glossary_role_card_Nun} and end the protection.
event.card.request_stolen_return: {character} asks {holder} whether they can return the {role} card after a {glossary_role_Baron} theft.
event.card.failure.holder_left: {holder} is no longer at the table.
event.card.retrieve_nun_still_protected: The {glossary_role_Nun} {nun} retrieves their {glossary_role_card_Nun} from {holder}, but {holder} remains protected by another {glossary_role_card_Nun}.
event.card.retrieve_nun_revoke: The {glossary_role_Nun} {nun} retrieves their {glossary_role_card_Nun} from {holder} and revokes protection from {holder}.
